resources.string: Review automation, alert and manual-action activity stored locally on this device.

Card explaining that the usage summary is stored only on this device.

This summary is stored in AquaLight’s private app data on this device. It is not sent to Firebase, used for advertising or shared as analytics. It is cleared when you sign out, delete your account or clear the app’s data.
